description: This file defines the AlertDAO interface, which specifies database operations related to Alert objects within the OpenMRS notification module. It includes method signatures for saving, retrieving, deleting, and listing alerts.

classes.name: AlertDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for Alert objects including save, retrieve, delete, and list.

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Saves a new Alert object to the database or updates an existing one, returning the saved Alert.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an Alert by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Alerts for a specific user, with options to include read or voided alerts.

methods.name: deleteAlert
methods.description: Deletes the specified Alert from the database.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all alerts, with optional filtering for expired alerts.
